RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Gate Telemetry
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Compare recovered route recordings with the gate's own timing records. Unlocks a persistent route-planning view of surveyed rooms and their known connections before a repeat expedition; unexplored rooms stay unknown.\n\nThe first rung. One completed route log is enough, because one survey is all a branch has when it starts.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Field Stability
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Read the distortion records against the gate's power trace and find what the connection was doing when the corridors stopped agreeing with the map. Lengthens how long a connection holds.\n\nNeeds the space to have misbehaved while somebody was recording it. A branch that has only ever had quiet runs has nothing to read.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Sustained Aperture
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: Hold a wider threshold open for longer without the reserve collapsing. Lengthens a connection again, and it is the point at which what lives down there can follow a crew all the way out.\n\nRequires an entity log: the company will not authorise a wider aperture on the word of a crew that has never met anything.

RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.label: Standing Connection
RimroomsAsyncIndustries.Investigation.Ri.description: A connection that no longer counts down. It holds for as long as the gate is powered, staffed and fed — and it ends the instant any of those stops, exactly as before.\n\nThe top of the ladder, and the most expensive thing a branch can learn. It asks for everything: routes surveyed, the space caught misbehaving more than once, and more than one thing seen and written down.
